plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate based on typical task token consumption and are for reference only. All membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage; credits refresh each month. Kimi Code has separate 5-hour and weekly rate limits, but no numeric limits are stated on this page.
